newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: DETAILS OF SLOVAK JULY 1997 CONSUMER INFLATION.
newsitem.headline: DETAILS OF SLOVAK JULY 1997 CONSUMER INFLATION.

text.p: The following are details of Slovak consumer inflation for June 1997 as released by the Statistical Bureau (SUSR) on Tuesday.
SLOVAK CONSUMER INFLATION July 97 June 97 July 96
Note. All figures are positive unless stated otherwise.
SUSR said that due to changes in the population's expenditure structure, it had revised formulas for calcuating CPI, using 1995 as a base year.
SUSR released revised month-on-month figures for 1996 under the new methodology, but it did not release revised year-on-year figures for 1996.
Figures in brackets show changes against December 1995, the base month for the new formula. SUSR also added new items to the inflation basket, and modified others.
The number of basket items has been cut to 708 from the previous 836. The new basket has 11 main divisions and 38 groups.

The new basket divisions are: foodstuffs and soft drinks (140 items); alcohol, tobacco and pharmaceuticals (12 items), clothes and shoes (125 items); household energy, utilities and fuels (46 items); furniture, household appliances and maintenance (92 items); healthcare (21 items); transport (54 items); recreation and culture (77 items); education (6 items); hotels, cafes and restaurants (49 items); various goods and services (86 items).

CPI indexes were previously published in four main groups of items -- foodstuffs, non-food items, public catering, services-- and 34 sub-groups. The weighting of the new items will be calculated based on data monitored from household accounts for 1995.
